extra.rationale: + CKD: OTC sleep aids are mostly anticholinergic antihistamines (diphenhydramine/doxylamine) that accumulate and worsen confusion/retention with reduced renal clearance, so CKD should prompt caution and favor non-drug sleep measures or clinician input.
